title: J1 beat 13 on what is built: pause stops the program with reason pause and freezes the plant; resume advances it; stop stops the program, not the session
notes: The run-control subset of pause-resume-stop at corpus:plant-io's own 100 ms interval (no deploy step yet for the 500 ms task) and with the session's status request in place of GET /api/status's debug block (not built), so it does not discharge A033's 20-pause bound or its status-API read. Nor the plant freeze after stop: the reference plant is a runtime plugin and stops with the program (its socket is gone within 800 ms of the stop), so no plant read is possible once the program is stopped.

steps.note: runState events queue in arrival order, so the state is read back
